indicator_name: GDP excluding mining (section B), 2010 prices, seasonally adjusted
description: ВВП без горнодобывающей промышленности в ценах 2010 г., с исключением сезонного фактора
unit: million KZT, average 2010 prices, seasonally adjusted
methodology: Derived from the item-level dataset QNA_GVA_BY_SECTION_SA_CONSTANT_2010, item GDP minus B. Element 283162 «ВВП методом производства (на квартальной основе)», sheet 6: 26 rows (goods/services/industry aggregates, sections A–T, ВДС, чистые налоги, ВВП), 2010 Q1 – 2026 Q1 on 2026-09-23 (the table lags the cumulative dynamic table 4439 by one quarter).
transformation: seasonally and calendar adjusted, average 2010 prices, discrete quarter, as published; quarterly national accounts vintage -- see metadata
